However, Wikipedia may: - Lack up-to-date information (e.g., if the win was announced after the last edit). - Cite secondary sources without direct verification (e.g., “per HBO” or “per Emmy Awards”). - Be subject to editorial bias or omission (e.g., if the article prioritizes other achievements).
